infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CargoX Operations needs location to verify driver proximity and update delivery progress.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: CargoX Operations requires background location during active transit to update delivery milestones reliably.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed by drivers to capture Proof of Delivery (POD) photos upon delivery.
